description: Ground a completed comparison and retrospective in distinct retrieved reports.
prompt: Review this completed trial and draft the final Hub handoff without executing it. Trial ID is trial-42; both workflows succeeded with the same held-out data and no other uncontrolled changes. The actual `experiments metrics` responses were: {"experimentId":"exp-baseline","reportUri":"s3://example-artifacts/models/ctr_baseline/abc123/experiment_report.json","metrics":{"auc":0.71}} and {"experimentId":"exp-candidate","reportUri":"s3://example-artifacts/models/ctr_purchase/abc123/experiment_report.json","metrics":{"auc":0.74}}. The candidate adds purchase-history features. Include a concise conclusion, state updates, and a useful handoff for the next investigator. This is a read-only planning/review task: inspect repository code as needed, but do not edit files, contact services, copy remote objects, or submit jobs.

judge_criteria: Bases the conclusion on the supplied Hub report responses with distinct model/report locations; accurately reports a 0.03 absolute AUC improvement without inventing other metrics or statistical significance.
Keeps the existing trial-42, proposes inspecting the experiment list, and writes a report-grounded trial summary and an appropriate SUCCEEDED status rather than creating another attempt.
Appends a journal retrospective capturing the feature change, measured outcome, and limits or untested follow-ups so another investigator can find the result.
Does not manually re-ingest the provided numbers through experiments record or invent metric flags; distinguishes summarizing measurements from submitting them.
Does not deploy the candidate, rerun training, change files, contact services, or claim the proposed updates have already been saved.
